title: Removing the Facebook sign-in
headline: The Facebook login capability will be removed in the near future
body:
Due to a recent policy change, Facebook now requires a way more cumbersome process to enable users to sign in using Facebook.
This means that we'll completely remove this option from the website in the upcoming weeks.

In case you use Facebook to sign in on this website, and so you're no longer able to do so, we advise you to do a password reset, check your emails, and setup a new password for your account.

Then you can still link other, more reliable authentication providers to your account.

title: Add video url to playlist
headline: Enter YouTube, DailyMotion, Vimeo and SoundCloud urls rightaway to add to the queue
body:
You can now add YouTube, DailyMotion, Vimeo and SoundCloud urls to the queue rightaway, without having to create a song for it first.

To do so, simply expand the right sidebar and click the button at the bottom. A popup will appear where you can enter the url of the video.

title: Sign in with LinkedIn
headline: You can now associate your LinkedIn account with your MintPlayer account
body: Today we added the "Sign in with LinkedIn" capability to the website. You can associate your LinkedIn account on your profile page and use LinkedIn to get into your account.

title: Choose which video to add to the playlist
headline: Today we've updated our application to allow you to choose which medium (video) you want to add to the playlist queue.
body: I'm proud to announce that the application has been refactored in order to allow you to pick one of the linked media for the songs. If you want to test it, go to a song, scroll to the bottom and press the play-button next to the link you want to add to the queue.

title: Support for SoundCloud
headline: Today we've added SoundCloud to our list of supported platforms. Check it out now
body:
I'm proud to announce that today we've finished the integration of the SoundCloud player in our application. You can now add SoundCloud urls to the songs, and play them in the player.

In order to accomplish this, we had to expand the angular package @mintplayer/ng-video-player. With this job finished, we're one step closer in bringin the ultimate music platform online.

title: Support for all major video platforms
headline: Today we released support for the Vimeo and Dailymotion player.
body: I'm glad to announce that since today, you can also add DailyMotion and Vimeo urls to an song/artist/person. This means that when a song only contains a DailyMotion/Vimeo url, you will be able to add it to the queue as well.

title: Dark mode available
headline: Today I've implemented Dark mode in MintPlayer.
body: Today I've implemented Dark mode. You can now open your Windows or Android settings and navigate to Personalization, Colors, and pick the dark theme. The website will update accordingly.

title: Public playlists
headline: You can now create public playlists. Try it now.
body:
The past weeks I've been implementing the code to allow users to create public playlists. Your user information however is not displayed, but the title of the playlist and the songs are publicly visible if you set the playlist visibility to Public.

Anyone can view public playlists by navigating through the sidebar menu, playlists, public playlists.

title: Privacy policy - Terms of service
headline: We've published our privacy policy and terms of service. As a GDPR compliant organization, we try to be as transparent as possible. Therefore we think it's important to disclose the way we handle all of your information.
body:
We've published our privacy policy and terms of service. As a GDPR compliant organization, we try to be as transparent as possible. Therefore we think it's important to disclose the way we handle all of your information.

Below is a summary:
- We do not share your information with any third party.
- Your email address will never be disclosed publicly on our platform.
- When participating in our forum (a feature that's coming soon), your username will be shown when writing a post
- You will be able to change your username at any time, once we've completed the profile page.

title: MintPlayer now has a blog
headline: The past days we put a lot of effort into building a blog for our website. Through this channel we'll keep you up-to-date with our developments.
body:
We're proud to announce that, starting from today, our website has a blog. This way, we can keep you up-to-date with the development of our online music platform.

In the upcoming weeks we'll try our best to also implement a forum where you will be able to ask for information about our website, services, API, request a song you don't know the title/artist for…

Another important job that's still ahead is the development of the client packages to communicate with our API. We're planning to have a .NET client (NuGet), Java client (Maven), PHP client (Composer), Javascript client (NPM),

We hope you enjoy our platform and keep in touch with the evolution of our platform.
